lines.en: label futabasummer2noongen:
scene futabasummer2noongen
I call Futaba and the two of us make plans to revisit the bookstore she likes.
lines.zh: 我给 Futaba 打了电话，我们约好再去一次她喜欢的那家书店。

lines.en: It seems that things have gotten a lot livelier here since the first time we came.
lines.zh: 自打我们第一次来之后，这里似乎热闹了不少。

lines.en: Several more floors have been added on, each with their own distinct theme or specialty.
lines.zh: 又加了好几层，每层都有各自鲜明的主题或专长。

lines.en: But, seeing as neither of us want to climb any more stairs, we surrender ourselves to the second floor and spend the afternoon there, discussing different writers and remembering how far apart our tastes are.
lines.zh: 不过既然我们俩都不想再爬楼梯，就干脆认命待在二楼，在那儿过了一个下午，聊着不同的作家，也重新想起我们的品味差得有多远。

lines.en: It’s funny...the way that, despite having not read a single book since waking up in the classroom all that time ago, I still remember what I do and do not like.
lines.zh: 说来好笑……尽管从很久以前在教室里醒来之后我就一本书都没读过，我却还记得自己喜欢什么、不喜欢什么。

lines.en: But I guess that we all have parts of ourselves that can’t be destroyed by anything. And that we don’t need to actively attempt to remember our past as it’ll wind up crawling back on its own.
lines.zh: 不过我想，我们每个人身上都有某些部分是任何东西都毁不掉的。而我们也不必刻意去记起过去——它自己会爬回来的。

lines.en: Futaba must catch onto my slip into existential territory as she switches herself into shopping mode, grabbing a few things off the shelves before announcing that she’s ready to leave.
lines.zh: Futaba 大概察觉到我滑进了存在主义的领域，便切换成购物模式，从书架上抓了几本书，然后宣布她可以走了。

lines.en: scene black
The trip back home isn’t as quiet as the tail end of our bookshop “date,” with Futaba utilizing the time to discuss the latest happenings in the lives of her two closest friends.
lines.zh: 回家的路上并不像我们那场书店「约会」的尾声那么安静，Futaba 利用这段时间讲起了她两个最亲密的朋友最近的近况。

lines.en: When I ask her why she doesn’t talk more about {i}her{/i} life, she takes a look around, as if to shield herself from the embarrassment of anyone but me hearing her, and says-
lines.zh: 我问她为什么不多聊聊{i}自己{/i}的生活，她环顾了一下四周，像是怕被我以外的人听见而难为情，然后说道——

lines.en: “This is my life.”
It’s a little corny, but the dying light of the sun reflecting off of her skin makes it seem like the end of a movie.
lines.zh: 这话有点老套，可残阳映在她皮肤上，让它看起来像电影的结尾。

lines.en: It isn’t, though...as I’m unable to think up a proper response and give her back nothing more than, “I see...”
lines.zh: 可它并不是……因为我想不出什么得体的回应，只能还给她一句「这样啊……」

lines.en: When, in all actuality, I don’t.
lines.zh: 而实际上，我根本没明白。

lines.en: Everything has already faded to black.

{i}Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!{/i}
